items.conditional_limitation: Pinned author train_sup_mosi steps representation/non-CLUB optimizers first, recomputes features, then steps CLUB critics. Exact source update ordering requires main optimizer training_loss(include_critic_fit=False), followed by a separate critic optimizer critic_learning_loss on recomputed complete latents. Combined scalar default is an explicit simultaneous-update adaptation. Appended scalar conditioning follows the author practical appended-one-hot estimator but does not establish exact conditional negative sampling or theoretical bounds for continuous sentiment. Neither MI estimation nor CPU tests establish improved task performance.
items.remaining_risk: All-pairs concatenated critics scale quadratically in valid utterance count; formal training memory and throughput have not been measured.
checks: all objective branches receive finite gradients
six signed source terms per pair
